children.help_text: The vertical offset of the shadow. A positive value puts the shadow below the box, a negative value puts the shadow above the box

children.name: blur
children.label: Blur
children.help_text: The blur radius. The higher the number, the more blurred the shadow will be

children.name: spread
children.label: Spread
children.help_text: The spread radius. A positive value increases the size of the shadow, a negative value decreases the size of the shadow

children.name: inset

children.name: color

children.help_text: The color of the shadow
